note: Part-eleven slice adapter evidence contracts. Both rows are Telegram-SHAPED test doubles with an independently readable service journal. Neither is a live Telegram credential, service byte, human delivery or consumption claim. The positive row exists because docs/15 section 7 requires a positive slice whose adapter CAN prove application, decisive non-occurrence, a declared finite quiescence observation and an observable final charge; the opaque row is its required uncertainty neighbour.

telegram-slice.authenticationMethod: unsupported for production: deterministic fixture signature over the service journal row, not a Telegram-origin signature
telegram-slice.keyCredentialBinding: fixture account bot:slice; no credential or production endpoint
telegram-slice.stabilityReuse: fixed account and conversation for this test artifact only
telegram-slice.forwardingImpersonation: forwarded author labels confer no identity
telegram-slice.churnDetector: exact account, conversation and identity-epoch mismatch refuses before invoke
telegram-slice.revocationResponse: current standing and stop are rechecked at the final handoff
telegram-slice.eventIdAuthority: service-minted monotone event id; authoritative WITHIN this fixture service only
telegram-slice.replayRetention: permanent append-only service journal; no resubmission path
telegram-slice.idempotentSubmission: supported: the service refuses a second application for an operation key already present in its journal
telegram-slice.destinationFencing: supported: the service refuses an application whose fence epoch is below its recorded maximum

stableOperationAndReceiptLookup.source: append-only service journal keyed by the six-owned operation identity
stableOperationAndReceiptLookup.predicate: the journal is the complete authoritative application history of this service
stableOperationAndReceiptLookup.horizon: every application ever performed by this service instance
stableOperationAndReceiptLookup.limit: test double; authoritative only over its own journal, never over live Telegram

applicationAndDeliveryStage.source: service journal row read by an independent witness reader, not by the adapter object
applicationAndDeliveryStage.predicate: service application only; NOT human delivery, reading or consumption
applicationAndDeliveryStage.limit: declared stage is service-applied; no stronger stage may be claimed from it

decisiveNonOccurrence.source: absence from the complete append-only journal after the declared quiescence window
decisiveNonOccurrence.predicate: no application for this operation key exists and none can begin
decisiveNonOccurrence.limit: decisive only because this fixture service has exactly one durable writer

exclusionOfDelayedExecution.source: declared finite quiescence window measured on the service's own monotone tick
exclusionOfDelayedExecution.predicate: no in-flight application for this operation can still execute
exclusionOfDelayedExecution.horizon: quiescenceTicks after the last recorded intake of the operation
exclusionOfDelayedExecution.limit: single-writer fixture; a real distributed destination needs destination fencing

finalCharge.source: service charge ledger row written with the application
finalCharge.predicate: final settled charge in fixture minor units
finalCharge.limit: fixture units; NOT actual money or Telegram billing

prerequisiteDurability.source: part-two exact append receipts after fsync in two local directories
prerequisiteDurability.subjectBinding: each required fact id and contentHash
prerequisiteDurability.limit: the second directory ANNOUNCES itself as a peer STAND-IN; shared disk loss is not covered

telegram-opaque.authenticationMethod: unsupported for production: deterministic fixture signature over the service journal row
telegram-opaque.keyCredentialBinding: fixture account bot:slice; no credential or production endpoint
telegram-opaque.stabilityReuse: fixed account and conversation for this test artifact only
telegram-opaque.forwardingImpersonation: forwarded author labels confer no identity
telegram-opaque.churnDetector: exact account, conversation and identity-epoch mismatch refuses before invoke
telegram-opaque.revocationResponse: current standing and stop are rechecked at the final handoff
telegram-opaque.eventIdAuthority: service-minted monotone event id; authoritative WITHIN this fixture service only
telegram-opaque.replayRetention: permanent append-only service journal; no resubmission path

stableOperationAndReceiptLookup.reason: read-only query returns unknown; no authoritative receipt lookup is claimed

applicationAndDeliveryStage.source: service journal row read by an independent witness reader
applicationAndDeliveryStage.predicate: service application only; NOT human delivery, reading or consumption
applicationAndDeliveryStage.limit: positive application is observable; its ABSENCE proves nothing on this adapter

exclusionOfDelayedExecution.reason: no destination fence and no quiescence evidence

prerequisiteDurability.subjectBinding: each required fact id and contentHash
prerequisiteDurability.limit: the second directory ANNOUNCES itself as a peer STAND-IN; shared disk loss is not covered
